name_input: JCBL LTD; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LTD; J C B L LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL LIMITED; JCBL Ltd.; J C B L LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for JCBL LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/jcbl-limited) shows 125 records, but the visible rows are INBOUND shipments into India, e.g. "2026-02-20 | DS-DYNAMIC SOLUTION S.R.O. | JCBL LIMITED | PISTON PUMP AC12.03 PVAMA | BRATISLAVA, SLOVAK REP | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 84142090 | 7642081" and "2026-02-18 | CEMAR INTERNATIONAL INDUSTRIAL LLC | JCBL LIMITED | TLC 200 BR GLASS F/D/R 42X500X850 MM | DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 87089900 | 7607092". No outbound (India-origin) export row with date/destination/HS/B-L was visible on the free view; the 'Buyers' block lists JCBL LIMITED only as a co-listed name under third-party buyers (GALAXI INTERNATIONAL FZCO, CEMAR INTERNATIONAL INDUSTRIAL LLC), not as a confirmed exporter of record. Source counter: page claims "Total Shipments 125 Records detected"; rows actually seen in free view = 5 (all import-side).
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report revenue splits could not be read: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JavaScript challenge, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this run. No GSTIN, turnover figure or contract record was observed, so none is asserted.
note: Only import-side customs rows were observable; no export bill-of-lading with India as origin was seen, so export_status is declared_only rather than confirmed — the company's own site/catalogue claims are not treated as fact per Rule 5. Declared HS 820600 (hand tools) does not match any observed row (observed HS 84142090, 87089900, 87116020, 87082200, 85122010, all imports of automotive/EV components for R&D and actual use) — per Rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual traded codes. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources, not invented). No evidence of liquidation/bankruptcy was found, so no rejection basis. Follow-up needed: paid Volza/Export Genius export-side query and GST/GeM lookup to move export_status and domestic_status off unknown.
